اضطهدا (form VIII)
# اِضْطَهَدَا (iḍṭahadā) /idˤ.tˤa.ha.daː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
# اُضْطُهِدَا (uḍṭuhidā) /udˤ.tˤu.hi.daː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
# اِضْطَهِدَا (iḍṭahidā) /idˤ.tˤa.hi.daː/: second-person dual imperative of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
